items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...would you see that in New York at the Lincoln Theater and Washington at the Howard Theater... [INTERVIEWEE] That was Sister Foster.

ctx.x: When you go to New York, you know, you'd get a half of...the first half. Yes. Of the whole...the whole...the first half. And then somebody else had the second half. Well, then instead of us getting just the first half, we'd have the first half. And they'd say, can you change your act for the second half? Yes. Then can you change for next week? And would you see that in New York at the Lincoln Theater and Washington at the Howard Theater and all of those theaters. Well, instead of keeping us just the three days or…
What do you want? If you want to answer the phone, it's all right. I can turn this off for a while.
